restrained.said: Six reinsurers carry $310M above a $50M retention.
Each layer sits on the one below it, split across the reinsurers who took a share of it.
Retention: fifty million dollars, kept by the client.
Layer 1: forty million dollars excess of fifty million dollars; Globex Re sixty percent, Meridian Re forty percent.
Layer 2: seventy million dollars excess of ninety million dollars; Acme Re forty percent, Vantage Re thirty-five percent, Umbra Re twenty-five percent.
Layer 3: two hundred million dollars excess of one hundred sixty million dollars; Acme Re thirty percent, Globex Re twenty-five percent, Helios Re twenty percent, open twenty-five percent.
